name: 5+1 Context (Detokenized), Frequency-Ordered WordNet Glosses
description: Identical to p001 but the context is detokenized from the Penn-Treebank-style source tokens into natural English (punctuation, contractions, and quotation marks restored) before the target is marked. English fine-grained WSD prompt using the target sentence with 5 preceding and 1 following sentence, <t>...</t> target marking, WordNet sense keys, definitions, synonyms, and usage examples. Candidate senses are ordered by WordNet frequency; the model returns JSON with sense_index.

messages.content: You are an English linguist performing fine-grained Word Sense Disambiguation. WordNet glosses are schematic. Use the sentence context, the examples, and the synonyms to choose the best indexed sense. Do not hedge. Choose the single best indexed sense.
